hamburg-travemuende-bay-old-roads.slogan: Sea air, brick towns and lake-country bends without motorway boredom.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Baltic Coast Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 31 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

seattle-mount-rainier-sunrise-loop.title: Seattle · Mount Rainier Sunrise Loop
seattle-mount-rainier-sunrise-loop.slogan: A 283 km loop out of Enumclaw fuel
seattle-mount-rainier-sunrise-loop.story: Volcano views with serious seasonal checks. 283 km round from Enumclaw - plan on about 5 h 26 of riding. The stops in between: Packwood and Mount Rainier. Sunrise Road is the high point. It tops out at about 1,550 m. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: This Sunrise Road → Packwood food stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
